result.summary: The page is generally well-designed and polished, with one minor layout concern where content is clipped at the bottom edge of the viewport.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (the pizza promo card with the '-20%' badge) is clipped at the bottom of the screen. Only the card image and badge are visible, while the restaurant name, rating, delivery info, and cuisine type are cut off, making the card appear incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scroll container padding so full cards are visible above the fold, or add a bottom fade/gradient and snap-to-card scrolling to clearly indicate that more content is available below.
